notes: Single source for the pre-screening interview defaults shared by the Next.js app (lib/prescreen.ts) and the Python voice agent (voice-agent/lib/prescreen.py). Do not copy these values into either codebase.
A pre-screen is an Application with kind = prescreen and no job. Wherever the pipeline needs job fields, both sides build the same stand-in job from these values plus the candidate's own profile.
jobTitle: the candidate's Preferred Role, else the position of their most recent work experience, else titleFallback. {title} in idealCandidateProfile is replaced with that value.
description: Pre-screening interview with no specific job attached. Assess the candidate's readiness for the role they are targeting.
idealCandidateProfile: A capable {title} with the skills and experience shown in the candidate's own profile.
greeting: introduce yourself as the AI interviewer for their pre-screening interview on Just Be You, and ask if they're ready to begin.
